learning_outcomes.text: Students know the basic concepts related to addiction, types of addiction, symptoms, and causes.
Students explain the negative consequences of addiction.
Students analyze individual and societal risk factors for addictions.
Students know individual and societal responsibilities in the fight against addictions.
Students care about preventing addiction and supporting individuals affected by addiction.

syllabus_topics: Risk Factors and Protective Factors in Addiction
Prevention Perspective in the Fight Against Addiction
Policies and Action Plans in the Fight Against Addiction
Introduction to Substance Addiction and Criteria
Causes and Risk Factors of Substance Addiction
Introduction to Alcohol Addiction and Criteria
Causes and Risk Factors of Alcohol Addiction
Effects of Alcohol Addiction on Health
Introduction to Tobacco Addiction and Criteria
Causes and Risk Factors of Tobacco Addiction
Effects of Tobacco Addiction on Health and Environment
Industry and New Generation Tobacco Products
Current Issues Related to Addictions and Closing
